availability: Free developer preview · requires Apple Music Controls-enabled Ledge
description: Adds Apple Music controls to Ledge's player and lock screen: favorite or unfavorite the current song, add it to one of your playlists, toggle shuffle and repeat, and see Apple Music's actual Playing Next queue. Click Play Next on an upcoming song to move it right after the current one. Library actions need Automation permission for Music, which macOS asks for the first time you use them. Turn queue, favorites and playlists on or off separately in the add-on's settings. Removing the add-on removes these controls; playback, seeking and output selection stay in Ledge. Queue access uses private macOS APIs and is experimental; it only works with Apple Music and shows up to 12 upcoming songs. Requires the updated Ledge host with apple-music-queue support; older hosts cannot install this package.
